name: Begging
overview: Scripture teaches that God provides for His people so that the righteous will not be left begging for bread, as seen in Psalms 37:25 and Psalms 23:1. However, the Bible also warns against slothfulness, illustrating that laziness leads to begging, while diligence results in provision (Proverbs 13:4, Proverbs 20:4). Furthermore, God’s discipline, including hunger, serves to teach reliance not on physical sustenance alone but on His word (Deuteronomy 8:3), and humility in seeking forgiveness, as demonstrated by Joseph’s brothers, reflects a heart posture aligned with God’s grace (Genesis 50:17).
